Record denoising

Remove crackle, needle hiss and hum. Compare before and after.

The tool is free. Log in or sign up to use it.

Log inSign up

  1. Choose a file

  2. Source medium

  3. Strength and options

    Strength

  4. Confirm and start

What you get

  • Denoised recording in FLAC and MP3
  • Before / after comparison in one player
  • A measurement of how many dB of noise was removed
  • Private files, deleted after 24 hours

How it works

Classic signal processing, no AI: rumble filter, click detection and interpolation, spectral subtraction using a noise profile from the quietest passage (usually the lead-in groove), band limiting and loudness normalisation. It takes a few seconds on an ordinary server.

Fonoteka

An open archive of Polish recordings from 1918–1939 in the public domain.

Fonoteka is free and non-commercial. Public-domain materials are marked with the Public Domain Mark.
